**4B.1 Research Note: Ali Khamenei (2024)**

**Bottom line:** I found no reliable evidence that Khamenei genuinely accepted free, fair, and meaningful electoral contestation in 2024. The year’s evidence points in the opposite direction: candidate filtering, loyalist dominance, and a legitimacy crisis signaled by very low turnout. I found no strong pro-competition evidence beyond the existence of an election process itself.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Iran’s presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879 | Reuters reported that Khamenei ensured candidates sharing his hard-line views dominated the presidential contest, with the Guardian Council acting as a hard-line vetting body aligned to him. This is strong evidence against genuine acceptance of free and fair contestability. | 4B.1; also 3B.4 |
| [Iran’s Khamenei says turnout presidential election lowest since 1979 revolution](https://www.yahoo.com/news/irans-khamenei-says-turnout-presidential-103618264.html) | Reuters via Yahoo News | 2024-07-03 | https://www.yahoo.com/news/irans-khamenei-says-turnout-presidential-103618264.html | Reuters said first-round turnout was about 40%, the lowest since the 1979 revolution, underscoring a severe legitimacy problem. Khamenei’s system did not produce elections that many citizens experienced as meaningfully competitive or representative. | 4B.1; also 3B.8, 3B.10 |
| [Iran’s leader grants clemency to 2,654 inmates, including foreign nationals](https://english.news.cn/20240617/61af4b6135bc4f07bd0d76069a67ffe7/c.html) | Xinhua | 2024-06-17 | https://english.news.cn/20240617/61af4b6135bc4f07bd0d76069a67ffe7/c.html | This shows discretionary state mercy, not electoral openness. It does not support contestable power; at best it shows the regime still controlled punishment and clemency from above. | 4B.1; also 3B.1 |

**Evidence on the other side**
- I found no credible 2024 evidence that Khamenei accepted meaningful electoral competition, tolerated opposition victory, or endorsed independent electoral contestation.
- The closest “positive” item is simply that an election was held and turnout was reported, but that is procedural and does not show genuine acceptance of free, fair elections.

**Search gap**
- No strong pro-4B.1 evidence surfaced in the 2024 record I checked.
- The best available evidence instead shows managed candidacy, loyalist dominance, and weak legitimacy.
